summary:
Young Astronauts: Lunar Base is an educational 3D adventure game about three young explorers who dream of travelling to space. Hoping to make their dream come true, they build a homemade catapult and launch themselves into the air. Their plan does not go as expected, but a friendly fictional alien comes to their rescue and takes them aboard his spaceship.

Guided by their new companion, they discover a lunar base and begin exploring what life beyond Earth could be like. Players can explore the habitat and its modules while learning about the challenges of living and working on the Moon, including life support, energy, resource management, and keeping the base safe and functional.

The game responds to NASA’s challenge by presenting space science through an engaging story and interactive 3D exploration. It aims to make complex ideas easier for younger audiences to understand, spark curiosity about science and technology, and show why future space missions require planning, cooperation, and problem-solving.💕
details:
Project Overview

Young Astronauts: Lunar Base is an educational 3D adventure game created to introduce younger audiences to space exploration and the challenges of living beyond Earth.

The project follows three young explorers who dream of travelling into space. Determined to make their dream come true, they build a homemade catapult and launch themselves into the air. Their unusual plan does not go as expected, but a friendly fictional alien comes to their rescue and takes them aboard his spaceship. This unexpected encounter begins an extraordinary adventure that eventually leads them to a lunar base.

Gameplay and Educational Purpose

Players can explore a 3D lunar habitat, discover its different modules, and experience an environment inspired by the challenges of a real lunar mission.

The educational focus is on helping young players understand what it takes to maintain a functioning base beyond Earth. The project introduces important topics such as life support, energy, resource management, safety, and the systems needed to support human life in a harsh environment.

Rather than presenting these topics only through traditional explanations, the game uses exploration, visual storytelling, and interactive gameplay to make space-related concepts more approachable and interesting.

Creativity and Impact

The project combines an imaginative storyline, a friendly alien character, humour, and educational exploration. Its aim is to turn complex scientific and engineering topics into an engaging experience for younger players.

By discovering the lunar habitat and learning about the challenges of living on the Moon, players are encouraged to develop curiosity about science, technology, teamwork, and the future of human space exploration.

Development and Tools

The game was created using PlayDrop Studio, an AI-assisted game creation platform. ChatGPT was used as a supporting tool during the planning process, developing the storyline, organizing ideas, and refining development instructions.

AI-assisted tools were also used in the creative development of visual and video materials accompanying the project.

Language Notice

The currently playable version of the game is available only in Polish. An English version is not available yet. We hope this does not prevent international players from enjoying the experience!

Cinematic Introduction – Watch Before Playing

The project includes an extended cinematic introduction that serves as the opening chapter of the game's story. It follows the three young explorers as they attempt to reach the sky using a homemade catapult, encounter a friendly alien, and begin their unexpected journey into space.

We recommend watching this video before starting the game, as it introduces the main characters, establishes the storyline, and provides the background for the adventure that follows.
